name: Cal.com
tagline: Open source scheduling infrastructure. The Calendly alternative you can self-host.
shortDescription: Cal.com is the open source Calendly. Scheduling links, calendar sync (Google, Outlook, iCloud), video conferencing (Zoom, Google Meet, Daily), payments via Stripe, team scheduling, round-robin, and 100+ integrations. Self-hostable in Docker.
longDescription:
## What it is

Cal.com is a scheduling platform that lets you share a link, get booked, and let your calendar handle the rest. It started as a Calendly clone in 2021 and has since grown into a complete scheduling infrastructure used by 200K+ users, with features Calendly still charges extra for (team scheduling, payments, workflows).

## Why we recommend it

It's the most-loved open source scheduling tool because it has every feature Calendly has and a few Calendly doesn't (white-label self-hosting, custom workflows, native Stripe integration, advanced routing). The free Cloud tier is generous; the self-hosted Docker image is one container; the paid tiers are 50–70% cheaper than Calendly's per-seat pricing.

## When to use it

- Individuals who are tired of paying Calendly $8–$16/user/mo
- Teams that need round-robin, collective, or pool scheduling (Calendly charges extra)
- SaaS apps that want to embed scheduling (Cal.com has a robust API + embed SDK)
- Companies that want to white-label scheduling (self-host, replace the Cal.com brand with yours)
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/calcom/cal.com.git && cd cal.com && yarn install
installInstructions:
**Self-host (most flexibility):**
1. `git clone https://github.com/calcom/cal.com.git`
2. `cd cal.com && yarn install`
3. Follow the [self-hosting guide](https://cal.com/docs/self-hosting) (requires Postgres, Redis, and a calendar OAuth app)

**One-click on Railway / Render / DigitalOcean:** Search "Cal.com" in the marketplace.

**Cloud (easiest):** Free tier (1 connected calendar, unlimited bookings). Teams: $15/user/mo. Enterprise: custom.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free, AGPL. Cloud Free: 1 calendar, unlimited bookings. Teams: $15/user/mo. Enterprise: custom.
